name: Calliope
author: homio13

sections.description:
Generate Professional-Quality Content Automatically, 24/7

Stop struggling with content creation. Calliope automatically generates professional-quality articles around the clock, giving you more time to focus on growing your business while maintaining consistent, high-quality content output. Perfect for bloggers who can’t find time to write, businesses struggling with content costs, and anyone who wants to scale their content marketing efforts.

Calliope is a powerful WordPress plugin that leverages advanced AI technology to automatically generate professional-quality, SEO-optimized content for your website. Whether you’re running a blog, news site, or content marketing platform, Calliope works 24/7 to create engaging articles that read like they were written by professional writers.

🎯 **Key Features**

  • ⚡ 36x Faster Content Creation: Generate articles in 5 minutes instead of 3 hours
  • 💰 Massive Cost Savings: Save $75,000 monthly vs. outsourcing (15 articles)
  • 🤖 24/7 Full Automation: Set it up once and let it generate content continuously
  • 📈 Automatic SEO Optimization: Generate content optimized for search engines
  • 🎨 Professional Quality: AI-generated content that matches professional writing standards
  • 🛡️ Risk-Free Trial: Try with 3 free articles before deciding

🚀 **How It Works**

  1. Setup (10 minutes): Configure your AI API keys and preferences
  2. Keywords: Add topics and keywords you want to create content about
  3. Automate: Calliope automatically generates professional-quality content based on your keywords
  4. Review: Optionally review and customize generated content before publishing
  5. Publish: Automatically post or schedule your content as needed

💼 **Ideal For**

  • Blog Owners: Maintain consistent, professional content output 24/7
  • Content Marketers: Scale your content marketing efforts automatically
  • Affiliate Marketers: Generate professional product reviews and comparison articles
  • Business Owners: Create company blogs and newsletters automatically
  • SEO Professionals: Build keyword-optimized content at scale
  • Anyone who wants professional-quality content generation automation

📊 **Proven Results & ROI**

  • 36x Efficiency Increase: 3 hours → 5 minutes per article
  • Massive Cost Reduction: $75,000 monthly outsourcing → $20/month with Calliope
  • Time Savings: Save 60 hours monthly (20 articles × 3 hours)
  • Revenue Protection: Prevent losing search rankings to competitors
  • Professional Quality: Content indistinguishable from human writers
  • 24/7 Automation: Content generation while you sleep

🔥 **Why Choose Calliope?**

  • WordPress Native: Built specifically for WordPress, seamless integration
  • Advanced AI Technology: Latest GPT-5, GPT-4o and ChatGPT technology
  • Automatic SEO: Built-in keyword optimization and search-friendly formatting
  • Competitive Analysis: Automatically analyze competitors and generate winning content
  • 100% Automation: From analysis to publication, completely hands-free
  • Professional Support: 24/7 expert assistance available

Support

24/7 Expert Support Available

  • 📧 Email Support: Get help via our support system
  • 💬 Live Chat: Real-time assistance when you need it
  • 📞 Phone Support: Direct support for urgent issues
  • 📚 Documentation: Comprehensive guides and tutorials

Visit our WordPress.org support forum for immediate assistance.

Pricing

Start Free, Scale as You Grow

  • 🆓 Free Plan: 3 articles per month (Perfect for testing)
  • 💼 Standard: $20/month for 15 articles (Most popular)
  • 🚀 Premium: $30/month for unlimited articles (For power users)

Risk-Free Guarantee: Try 3 articles free, cancel anytime, no commitments.

External Services

This plugin relies on the following third-party external services to provide its core functionality:

OpenAI API

Purpose: Generates AI-powered article content using GPT models.

Data Sent: Article keywords, custom prompts, language settings, and content generation parameters.

When: Every time an article is generated (either manually via test generation or automatically via scheduled cron jobs).

Service Provider: OpenAI, L.L.C.
* Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
* Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Google Custom Search API

Purpose: Performs competitor research and gathers related information for article generation.

Data Sent: Search keywords and search parameters.

When: During the article generation process when competitor research is enabled.

Service Provider: Google LLC
* Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Firebase Authentication (Google Identity Toolkit)

Purpose: Manages user authentication and account management for the Calliope service.

Data Sent: User email addresses and authentication credentials.

When: During user registration, login, and password reset operations.

Service Provider: Google LLC
* Terms of Service: https://firebase.google.com/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy

Calliope Stripe Handler Service

Purpose: Manages subscription billing and payment processing.

Data Sent: User email addresses and subscription plan selections.

When: During subscription registration, plan changes, and cancellation.

Service URL: https://stripehandler-3arzn46uba-uc.a.run.app
* This service acts as an intermediary to Stripe’s payment processing system
* Stripe Terms of Service: https://stripe.com/legal/consumer
* Stripe Privacy Policy: https://stripe.com/privacy

Important Privacy Note: By using this plugin, you acknowledge that your data will be transmitted to these external services as described above. Please review each service’s terms and privacy policies to ensure compliance with your local regulations and user agreements.

Credits

Calliope is developed with ❤️ for the WordPress community by content creators, for content creators.

Special Thanks To:
* OpenAI for providing the revolutionary AI technology
* WordPress Community for the amazing platform
* Our Beta Users for valuable feedback and testing

Built for 24/7 professional content generation automation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the calliope folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Calliope settings to configure your OpenAI API key
  4. Add your first keywords and start automated content generation
  5. Enjoy 24/7 professional-quality content creation!
sections.faq:
What AI models does Calliope support?

Calliope supports multiple AI models including GPT-5, GPT-4o and other OpenAI models. You can choose the model that best fits your needs and budget.

Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes, you’ll need a valid OpenAI API key to use Calliope. You can get one by signing up at OpenAI’s website. Costs vary depending on the model and usage.

Is technical knowledge required?

No technical knowledge required! Calliope is designed as a WordPress plugin that works like any other plugin. Setup takes just 10 minutes.

How good is the generated content quality?

Excellent! Calliope uses ChatGPT technology to generate content that reads like it was written by a professional. Many users report that the quality is indistinguishable from human-written content.

Can I customize the content generation prompts?

Yes, Calliope allows you to create custom prompts to tailor content generation to your specific needs and writing style.

Is the generated content unique?

Yes, Calliope generates unique content for each request. The AI creates original content based on your keywords and prompts.

Can I schedule content publication?

Yes, Calliope includes advanced scheduling features that allow you to automatically publish content at specific times.

Will Calliope affect my existing WordPress site?

No, Calliope works seamlessly with all WordPress themes and doesn’t interfere with existing functionality.

What about SEO optimization?

Calliope automatically optimizes content for SEO, including keyword integration, proper structure, and search-friendly formatting.

Is there a free trial?

Yes! You can try Calliope with 3 free articles before deciding to upgrade.

Can I cancel anytime?

Absolutely! There are no long-term contracts or commitments. Cancel anytime with one click.
sections.changelog:
3.0.17

  • 🔧 Bug Fix: Improved scheduler to use unique hook names per feed to prevent cron event conflicts when processing multiple feeds simultaneously

3.0.16

  • 🔧 Bug Fix: Fixed issue where articles were not generated correctly when running automatic generation scheduler with multiple feeds

3.0.15

  • 🔧 Refactor: Unified log levels (Logger::info/error/debug) for better log management
  • 🔧 Refactor: Reorganized API clients into Api directory (OpenAiClient, GoogleCseClient)
  • 🔧 Refactor: Simplified AutoGenerator directory structure

3.0.14

  • 🔧 Bug Fix: Fixed <style> tags being stripped by wp_update_post during permalink update

3.0.13

  • 🔍 Diagnostic: Changed to use generic logger event for diagnostics

3.0.12

  • 🔍 Diagnostic: Added tracking for <style> tag preservation issue investigation

3.0.11

  • 🔧 Bug Fix: Fixed embedded HTML <style> tags being stripped by WordPress during post save

3.0.10

  • 🔧 Bug Fix: Fixed database column name mismatch (calliope_feeds_id → feeds_id) causing article generation to fail on some environments

3.0.9

  • 🔧 Bug Fix: Fixed article generation failure caused by 4-byte UTF-8 characters (emoji) in generated content
  • 🗄️ Database: Migrated title and contents columns in feeds_schedule table to utf8mb4 charset
  • 📊 Logging: Added error logging for database update failures to improve debugging

3.0.8

  • 🔧 Bug Fix: Fixed embedded HTML not saving issue in feed edit page
  • 🛡️ WAF Bypass: Implemented Base64 encoding to prevent WAF blocking when saving HTML content
  • 🎨 Emoji Support: Added utf8mb4 support for embedded HTML field to allow emoji characters

3.0.7

  • 🔒 Security: Moved Google CSE API credentials to server-side for enhanced security
  • 📊 Analytics: Added GA4 event tracking for user behavior analysis

3.0.6

  • 🔧 Bug Fix: Added custom PSR-4 autoloader to fix class loading error during plugin activation

3.0.5

  • 🔧 Bug Fix: Resolved PHP library naming conflict to improve compatibility with other plugins

3.0.4

  • 🔧 Bug Fix: Performance improvements and stability enhancements

3.0.3

  • ⚡ Article Generation Performance Optimization: Improved SEO strategies and content quality

3.0.2

  • 🔧 Bug Fix: Performance improvements and stability enhancements

3.0.1

  • 🔧 Bug Fix: Performance improvements and stability enhancements

3.0.0

  • 🔧 Refactoring: Major refactoring of internal code

2.10.0

  • 🔧 Bug Fix: Performance improvements and stability enhancements

2.9.0

  • 🎉 WordPress.org Release: Official launch on WordPress plugin directory
  • 🔧 Enhanced Security: Improved security measures and data protection
  • ⚡ Performance Optimization: Faster content generation and better resource usage
  • 🌍 Internationalization: Full multilingual support
  • 🛡️ WordPress Standards: Complete compliance with WordPress coding standards

2.8.0

  • 🤖 Advanced AI Models: Support for latest GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini
  • 📈 SEO Enhancement: Improved keyword optimization features
  • 🎨 Custom Prompts: Advanced prompt customization features
  • 🔧 Bug Fixes: Performance improvements and stability enhancements

2.7.0

  • ⏰ Smart Scheduling: Advanced content scheduling and automation
  • 🎯 Targeted Content: Improved content targeting and personalization
  • 📊 Analytics: Enhanced content performance tracking
  • 🔒 Security: Additional security measures and data protection

2.6.0

  • 🌟 Multi-Model Support: Support for various AI models
  • 📝 Content Management: Improved content organization and editing
  • 🔍 SEO Tools: Advanced SEO optimization features
  • ⚡ Performance: Faster generation and better resource management
